name: SK oceanplant Co.,Ltd
summary: SK oceanplant Co.,Ltd. engages in manufacturing of steel and stainless steel pipe, hull block, and shipbuilding equipment in South Korea. The company supplies offshore wind power equipment; and shipbuilding products, such as T BHD blocks, fore ship blocks, mid ship mega blocks, FWD blocks, crude oil tanker mega blocks, bulk carrier mega blocks, container transverse bulkheads, engine casings, and deck houses. It provides oil and gas production facilities, including jackets and topsides for platform, deck module sub-structure for FPSO and TLP, SKID package, bridge and flare boom structures, PLEMS and subsea structures, and turret structures; and wind farm foundation structures, such as jackets…
